We may still be able to help you

Some health needs need a personalised programme rather than a listed one. This page only narrows things down — an Ayurvedic doctor assesses your health at consultation and tells you whether a suitable programme is available. Write to us in your own words; you do not need the right term or the right spelling.

Many patients come to us with more than one condition at once, and no single programme covers all of it. Others cannot say which problem to treat first, or are not sure what to call it. That is why we created the Personalised Programme, where an Ayurvedic doctor examines you and builds one plan around the whole picture — every condition, your medication, your history. We will tell you honestly whether we can help.
